description: Returns a single Observation Item with its full detail payload, including attachments, drawing links, root-cause associations, distribution members and custom field values. Also returns `download_all_attachments_uuid`, a token for bulk-downloading every attachment on the Observation.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Observation Item. Pass as the `{id}` path parameter to `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/items/{id}`, or as `filters[id]` when listing.

number.description: Human-facing identifier of the Observation within its Project. Assigned automatically from the next available number when not supplied on create. Sortable via `sort=number`.

name.description: Short title of the Observation, shown as the row label in the Observations list.

description.description: Plain-text rendering of the Observation description, with HTML markup stripped. Use for search indexing or plain-text export; use `description_rich_text` to render formatted content.

description_rich_text.description: Sanitized HTML version of the Observation description, safe to render in a rich-text viewer.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the Observation. `draft` is only produced for Observations governed by a workflow that has not yet been started. Filter collections with `filters[status]`, and read the s...

checklist_item.description: Inspection (Checklist) item this Observation was raised from. Null unless the Observation originated from an Inspection.

id.description: ID of the source Checklist Item.

checklist_list.description: Inspection (Checklist List) containing the source Checklist Item. Null unless the Observation originated from an Inspection.

id.description: ID of the source Checklist List.

priority.description: Urgency assigned to the Observation. Filter collections with `filters[priority]` and sort with `sort=priority`.

date_notified.description: Date the current assignee was last notified by email. Set when an assignee is added and cleared when the last assignee is removed. Null while the Observation is unsent — those Observations are the ...

due_date.description: Date the assignee is expected to resolve the Observation. Defaults from the Project's Observations configuration `days_due_default` when the client does not supply one.

closed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Observation last moved to `closed`. Null if the Observation has never been closed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Observation was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to the Observation. Use with `filters[updated_at]` to poll for incremental changes.

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Observation was sent to the recycle bin. Null for active Observations. Deleted Observations are only returned by the recycle bin endpoints.

personal.description: Whether the Observation is private. Private Observations are visible only to their creator, assignees, distribution members, and Observations admins. Defaults from the Project's `private_by_default...

current_drawing_revision_ids.description: IDs of the current revisions of every Drawing this Observation is pinned to. Empty when the Observation is not linked to any Drawing.

drawing_revisions.description: IDs of every Drawing Revision this Observation is associated with, including superseded revisions.

drawing_ids.description: Distinct Drawing IDs derived from `drawing_revisions`. Use to link back to the Drawings tool without resolving revisions yourself.

origin.description: The record this Observation was created from. Omitted when the Observation was created directly in the Observations tool. `payload` keys vary by `type`.

type.description: Kind of record the Observation originated from.

payload.description: Identifiers for the originating record. Only the keys relevant to `type` are present.

checklist_item_id.description: ID of the source Checklist Item. Present when `type` is `inspection`.

checklist_list_id.description: ID of the source Checklist List. Present when `type` is `inspection`.

coordination_issue_id.description: ID of the source Coordination Issue. Present when `type` is `coordination_issue`.

coordination_issue_number.description: Display number of the source Coordination Issue. Present when `type` is `coordination_issue`.

incident_action_id.description: ID of the source Incident Action. Present when `type` is `incident`.

incident_id.description: ID of the Incident owning the source Incident Action. Present when `type` is `incident`.

bim_model_id.description: ID of the source BIM Model. Present when `type` is `bim_model`.

bim_model_name.description: Title of the source BIM Model. Present when `type` is `bim_model`.

name.description: Human-readable label for the originating record, suitable for display as a breadcrumb back to the source tool.

viewpoint.description: Saved BIM camera position captured when the Observation was raised from a BIM Model. Present only when `origin.type` is `bim_model` and a viewpoint was captured.

id.description: ID of the BIM Viewpoint.

name.description: Name given to the saved viewpoint.

bim_file_id.description: ID of the BIM File the viewpoint was captured in.

camera_data.description: Opaque camera state (position, target, field of view) used by the BIM viewer to restore the saved view. Pass back to the viewer unmodified.

redlines_data.description: Opaque markup overlay data drawn on the viewpoint. Pass back to the BIM viewer unmodified.

sections_data.description: Opaque section-plane state applied to the model in this viewpoint. Pass back to the BIM viewer unmodified.

snapshot.description: Rendered still image of the viewpoint. An empty object when no snapshot image was stored.

id.description: ID of the snapshot file.

filename.description: Stored filename of the snapshot image.

name.description: Display name of the snapshot image.

url.description: Time-limited URL for downloading the snapshot image.

attachments.description: Files attached to the Observation. Each entry is either a Procore-stored file or a Procore Document Management document reference. Add attachments with `upload_ids` or `document_management_document...

assignee.description: Most recently added assignee. Omitted when the Observation has no assignees. When multiple assignees are supported, read the full list from `assignees` instead.

id.description: User ID of the assignee. Matches an `id` from `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/assignees`.

vendor.description: Company the assignee belongs to in this Procore company directory. Omitted when the assignee is not associated with a vendor.

id.description: Vendor ID of the assignee's company.

assignees.description: Every user currently assigned to the Observation, most recently added first. Omitted when the Observation has no assignees. Set with `observation[assignee_ids]`.

id.description: User ID of the assignee.

vendor.description: Company the assignee belongs to. Omitted when the assignee is not associated with a vendor.

distribution_members.description: Users copied on email notifications for this Observation. Omitted when the distribution list is empty. Set with `observation[distribution_member_ids]`.

id.description: User ID of the distribution member.

login.description: Email address the notification is sent to.

created_by.description: User recorded as the author of the Observation.

id.description: User ID of the creator.

name.description: Creator's name as stored on the Observation at creation time.

login.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Resolve the creator's email from the Directory using `created_by.id`.

vendor.description: Company the creator belongs to. Omitted when the creator is not associated with a vendor.

id.description: Vendor ID of the creator's company.

specification_section.description: Specification Section the Observation references. Omitted when no section is set.

id.description: ID of the Specification Section.

number.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Use `section` for the section number.

section.description: Section number as printed in the specification book.

latest_revision_url.description: Time-limited URL to the PDF of the section's current revision. Null when the section has no uploaded revision.

current_revision_id.description: ID of the section's current revision. Null when the section has no revisions.

viewable_document_id.description: ID of the viewable document generated for the current revision, for use with the document viewer. Null while conversion is pending.

location.description: Location the Observation was recorded at. Omitted when no location is set.

id.description: ID of the Location. Pass as `observation[location_id]` on create or update, or as `filters[location_id]` when listing.

name.description: Full multi-tier path of the Location, tiers joined with `>`.

node_name.description: Name of the deepest Location tier only, without its ancestors.

parent_id.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint.

trade.description: Trade responsible for the Observation. Omitted when no trade is set.

type.description: Observation Type classifying this Observation. Omitted only if the Observation has no type.

category.description: Localized display name of the type's Observations Category. Companies can define their own categories, so treat this as free-form text; use `category_key` for programmatic comparisons.

category_id.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Use `type.observations_category.id`.

name.description: Display name of the Observation Type, localized where a translation exists.

observations_category.description: The Observations Category the type belongs to. Managed via `GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/observations/categories`.

id.description: ID of the Observations Category.

name.description: Stable, unlocalized name of the category.

grouping.description: Top-level bucket the category rolls up to. Drives which Observations area the item appears in when the Company has group split enabled.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to the category.

company_active.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Read from `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/types` instead.

kind.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Read from `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/types` instead.

es.description: Translation of the type name for the `es` locale.
